parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The sender address. If this parameter is not specified, data for all addresses is returned.

parameters.name: DedicatedIp
parameters.description:
For dedicated IP users, specifies a dedicated IP address to query data for.

If this parameter is not specified, data for all dedicated IP addresses is returned.

parameters.name: DedicatedIpPoolId
parameters.description:
For dedicated IP users, specifies the ID of a dedicated IP pool to query data for.

If this parameter is not specified, data for all dedicated IP pools is returned.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The time span between the start time and end time cannot exceed 31 days. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

parameters.name: Esp
parameters.description:
For dedicated IP users, specifies a particular ESP to query data for. Valid values:
- gmail.com
- yahoo.com
- outlook.com
- icloud.com
- others: data for ESPs other than the ones listed above.

If this parameter is not specified, data for all ESPs is returned.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The time cannot be earlier than 90 days ago. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

parameters.name: TagName
parameters.description: The email tag. If this parameter is not specified, data for all tags is returned.
